answer: The beacon assignment is published and reef records each panel. Shards are assigned from the pearl graph, thus cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 4811 identities would post 1371 proofs and burn roughly 63 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
